title: S033 4.4.4 Use of broadcast and unicast
parent_path: S033 4.4.4 Use of broadcast and unicast

statements.subject: client
statements.description: When the DHCP client knows the address of a DHCP server, in either INIT or REBOOTING state, the client may use that address in the DHCPDISCOVER or DHCPREQUEST rather than the IP broadcast address.
actions: use known server unicast address as destination instead of IP broadcast address in DHCPDISCOVER or DHCPREQUEST

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client may also use unicast to send DHCPINFORM messages to a known DHCP server.
actions: send DHCPINFORM via unicast to known DHCP server address
